['Sixt SE '].company_description: Sixt SE is an international mobility service provider with about 2,000 locations in more than 100 countries. It operates in the business areas of vehicle rental, car sharing, ride-hailing, and subscription. The majority of the company is owned by the Sixt family, who manage the company, and the remaining share is tradeable stock.

['ArcelorMittal Bremen GmbH '].company_description: ArcelorMittal Bremen GmbH operates a steel production facility in Bremen, Germany, and produces more than 3.6 million tons of steel annually for several markets, including the automotive industry. The company has recently resumed production at its blast furnace and has ordered new copper staves for its steel plants.
